mapper.select: SELECT PROC_INST_ID_, BIZ_ID_, OLD_FORM_DATA_, FORM_DATA_, TENANT_ID_, CREATED_BY_ID_, CREATED_BY_NAME_, CREATED_TIME_, DELFLAG_, DISPLAY_ORDER_, MODIFIED_BY_ID_, MODIFIED_BY_NAME_, MODIFIED_TIME_, VERSION_ FROM wf_proc_inst_data where PROC_INST_ID_ = #{procId}
select * from rptrs_zybx_pre.act_hi_taskinst where proc_inst_id_ = #{processInstantId} order by id_

SELECT ID_, PROCESS_INSTANT_ID_, BIZ_ID_, PROC_INST_ID_, PROC_ID_, PROC_CODE_, PROC_NAME_, PROC_VERSION_, MODULE_CODE_, MODULE_NAME_, TEMPLATE_CODE_, TEMPLATE_NAME_, PROCESS_DEF_ID_, PROCESS_DEF_KEY_, PROCESS_DEF_NAME_, TASK_ID_, TASK_KEY_, TASK_NAME_, ACTION_, STAFF_CODE_, STAFF_NAME_, UNIT_CODE_, DEPT_CODE_, DEPT_NAME_, UNIT_NAME_, MEMO_, LOG_TIME_, NEXT_TASK_ID_, NEXT_TASK_KEY_, NEXT_TASK_NAME_, NEXT_STAFF_, DURATION_, NANO_TIME_, CONTENT_, TENANT_ID_, CREATED_BY_ID_, CREATED_BY_NAME_, CREATED_TIME_, DELFLAG_, DISPLAY_ORDER_, MODIFIED_BY_ID_, MODIFIED_BY_NAME_, MODIFIED_TIME_, VERSION_ FROM wf_his_proc_log WHERE PROCESS_INSTANT_ID_ = #{processInstantId} and dept_name_ = '法律合规部' ORDER BY LOG_TIME_

select * from ( select id_ id, proc_name_ "procName", proc_code_ "procCode", task_id_ "taskId", starter_code_ "starterCode", starter_name_ "starterName", starter_unit_code_ "starterUnitCode", starter_dept_code_ "starterDeptCode", starter_dept_name_ "starterDeptName", status_ "status", to_char(start_time_,'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mm:ss') "startTime" from wf_his_proc_inst where delflag_ = '1'
and proc_code_ = 'zyRel003'
and proc_code_ in ('zyzbejzdrel','zyzbejybrel','zyzbyizdrel','zyzbyjybrel','zybr_relGreat','zybr_relGeneral')
and proc_code_ = 'ZZ_Pro001'
and proc_code_ = 'WTSP001'
and proc_code_ = 'ZYCS003'
and proc_code_ = 'ZZ_Org001'
and starter_dept_name_ like '%' || #{param.starterDeptName} || '%'
and starter_name_ like '%' || #{param.starterName} || '%'
and status_ in ${param.status}
and start_time_ >= #{param.startTime}
and start_time_ <= #{param.endTime}
order by created_time_ desc )
